description: D-340 pressure fixture — the honest coarse wrapper (the Rust a_coarse_plugin_wraps_legacy_surface_honestly port). Declares granularity coarse, names its internal seams (seam:session-memory, seam:prompt-templates), flags extractionCandidate — the granularity-agnostic manifest (requirement #5): a whole legacy VIVIM chunk wearing the same schema an atomic plugin wears, honestly reporting its own coarseness so a later extraction has real seams to cut along. Its op reports the declared shape; the graph node must carry granularity coarse + extractionCandidate true.
